input.summary: Chapter 2 opens in Rickard's tent. Marro buckles the wounded captain's armor one-handed. The spears on the Black Wall above the ditch have doubled overnight, the Triarch's grain carts did not come, and Hesse reports two of Pallo's grey-clad men at the horse lines asking for a squire with a splinted hand. updates.body: The guard on the Black Wall above the company's ditch doubled overnight at the start of chapter 2: twelve spears where there had been six.
The Triarch's grain carts did not reach the camp at the start of chapter 2. Malaquo's clerk says the road is under repair.
Two of Pallo's men in grey came to the company camp at the start of chapter 2 and waited at the horse lines by Ash, asking after a squire with a splinted hand.

input.summary: By the cook fires, a sleepless Ser Tobbin asks Marro whether he has seen his sister Dagna, who has not come out to the camp in about a week and missed a visit two nights ago. Marro, who killed her, says he doesn't know where she is; Tobbin believes him and asks him to listen for news among the river folk. One of Pallo's grey men at the horse lines spots Marro.

updates.body: Dagna used to visit Tobbin at the company's ditch every few days with wine. Tobbin last saw her about a week before the start of chapter 2; she missed a visit due two nights before. He is searching for her and sleeping badly.
Marro lied to Ser Tobbin, telling him he doesn't know where Dagna is. Tobbin believed him and asked Marro to listen for news of her among the river folk; he promised to remember the kindness.
Ser Tobbin's manner: quiet, plain speech, calls Marro 'squire' or 'lad', covers worry with short laughs and jokes against himself.

thread_changes.title: Tobbin is looking for Dagna
thread_changes.body: Tobbin asked Marro to listen for news of his sister. Marro lied that he doesn't know where she is. The truth could surface through the river folk, the body, or Marro.

input.summary: Tobbin turns back and asks Marro to fetch Brother Olyvar for a blessing before he searches for Dagna, then remembers the septon is dead and buried outside the Black Wall. With no septon left in camp, he asks Marro to come say the prayers with him at Olyvar's grave. One of Pallo's grey men starts along the rail toward the cook fires. The scene ends there, with Marro's answer open.

updates.body: Since Brother Olyvar's death the Golden Company's camp has no septon. Ser Tobbin helped carry Olyvar to his grave outside the Black Wall.
Ser Tobbin asked Marro to come out to Brother Olyvar's grave and say the prayers with him for Dagna's safe return before he goes into the city to search for her. Marro has not answered.
One of Pallo's grey men has spotted Marro and is walking from the horse lines toward the cook fires.

thread_changes.body: Tobbin asked Marro to say the words with him at Olyvar's grave, out past the wall, before Tobbin goes looking for Dagna.
